targets.name: EU 2030 road-death benchmark (fatality component)
targets.policy_reference: EU Road Safety Policy Framework 2021-2030 – Next steps towards 'Vision Zero' (SWD(2019) 283)
targets.note: The EU Road Safety Policy Framework 2021-2030 sets the objective of halving road deaths and serious injuries between 2020 and 2030. The European Commission's own progress charts measure the road-death target against 2019, and this benchmark does the same (see the commitments page for both baselines). It covers road deaths only and does not by itself measure the serious-injury objective. Vision Zero is the long-term ambition of moving close to zero road deaths by 2050.
